prompt.zh-TW: 星橋物流今年營業利益 {{money:vars.oi}}，利息費用 {{money:vars.interest}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算財務槓桿度，以「倍」作答。
prompt.en: Starbridge Logistics had operating profit of {{money:vars.oi}} and interest expense (finance costs) of {{money:vars.interest}} this year. Using the course Excel basis, what is the degree of financial leverage? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_gkmknxh4}}＝{{term:tm_z3vbt800}} ÷（營業利益 － {{term:tm_k6t2e9wr}}）。利息是固定的，所以營業利益變動 {{percent:0.01|digits=0}} 時，{{term:tm_z971merj}}會變動（槓桿度 × {{percent:0.01|digits=0}}）；借得越多、利息越重，倍數越高。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_gkmknxh4}} = {{term:tm_z3vbt800}} ÷ (operating profit − {{term:tm_k6t2e9wr}}). Interest is fixed, so when operating profit moves by {{percent:0.01|digits=0}}, {{term:tm_z971merj}} moves by the degree of leverage times {{percent:0.01|digits=0}}; the more is borrowed and the heavier the interest, the higher the multiple.
